Orbitwright | Multiple Roles | Full-Time | Onsite | Los Angeles, CA | orbitwright.example.test

Orbitwright builds standard spacecraft platforms so that satellites can be made in volume.

We hire across the company: technicians, program managers, supply chain, and engineers in thermal, mechanical, power, avionics, embedded and ground software.

Apply at https://www.orbitwright.example.test/careers. Or email jobs [at] orbitwright [dot] example [dot] test with a resume.

NOTE: Due to export rules, you must be a US person (citizen, green card holder or similar) to work at Orbitwright. State your status in your email.
